scenicChapters.title: Niagara Escarpment Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 14 km this is Niagara Escarpment Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

story: From Milton it runs 96 km to Ancaster; allow about 1 h 51 of riding. It goes by way of Rattlesnake Point and Mount Nemo. The line favours views over speed.
